# Property Media Japan

> Real estate photography, property video, drone, floorplans and virtual staging in Niseko, Hokkaido, Japan. Operated by Nomado Godo Kaisha, NOMADO合同会社 (法人番号 9430003018070). Serves real estate agents, developers, hotels and owners across Niseko, Hirafu, Hanazono, Annupuri, Kutchan and Makkari.

Key facts:
- Services: interior and exterior real estate photography, dusk photography, JCAB-compliant drone photography and video, property walkthrough videos, vertical social cuts, 2D and 3D floorplans, virtual staging, CGI architectural rendering, hotel photography.
- Packages: Investor (properties under 80m2, 10 to 15 photos) and Residential (properties up to 300m2, 20 to 40 photos). Pricing is quoted per property on request.
- Experience: shooting real estate professionally since 2015; over 3,000 properties photographed in New Zealand (Auckland and Queenstown) between 2015 and 2024 before moving to Niseko in 2024.
- Founder: James Hirata, Bachelor of Architectural Studies, three years as an architectural visualisation 3D artist.
- No travel surcharge inside the Niseko area. Properties elsewhere in Hokkaido are quoted on request.
- Contact: team@propertymedia.jp, +81 90 3335 7122, or the enquiry form at https://www.propertymedia.jp/#contact

## Services
- [Real estate photography](https://www.propertymedia.jp/niseko-real-estate-property-photographer/): packages, dusk and drone add-ons
- [Property video](https://www.propertymedia.jp/niseko-real-estate-property-videographer/): walkthroughs, aerial and ground combos, social cuts
- [Floorplans, 3D and virtual staging](https://www.propertymedia.jp/niseko-real-estate-property-floorplan/): measured 2D plans, 3D plans, staging and CGI
- [Why choose us](https://www.propertymedia.jp/advantage/): experience, local coverage, pricing approach and FAQ
